english.name: pass_lv4-19

english.description: Even on days when you spend leisure time, you still engrave them in your heart
english.name: pass_lv4-30

english.description: You wanted to discard toys to show you have grown up, but you didn't expect the price of growing up to be loneliness
english.name: pass_lv4-37

english.description: It was originally a small white ball
english.name: pass_lv4-41

english.description: Whenever you get angry, you grind your teeth, but now there is no one to be angry at
english.name: pass_lv5-10

english.description: You have experienced countless new firsts together, such as eating canned food
english.name: pass_lv5-25

english.description: How long has it been? A day? A month? Or a year?
english.name: pass_lv5-27

english.description: You originally intended to keep it as a toy, but unexpectedly it eventually became a relic
english.name: pass_lv5-35

english.description: Every time you chew, you feel love surging in your heart
english.name: pass_lv5-37

english.description: This is the last apple left in the white house
english.name: pass_lv6-8

english.description: Since that day, you have seen more and more pears
english.name: pass_lv6-10

english.description: Since getting sick after mistakenly eating it, there hasn't been this kind of fruit in the house anymore
english.name: pass_lv6-18

english.description: You never imagined that one day this vessel filled with water would dry up
english.name: pass_lv6-22

english.description: You can't help but reminisce about the happy times you spent together
english.name: pass_lv6-26

english.description: You still remember that happy face blooming in the hot summer days
english.name: pass_lv6-31

english.description: ou have never been reproached, even if you accidentally spilled the water cup
english.name: pass_lv7-9

english.description: Ever since that day, you have hated the color red, including your previously favorite strawberry juice
english.name: pass_lv7-14

english.description: Are you sad because you can no longer taste familiar cheese? Or because you can never see that person again?
english.name: pass_lv7-32

english.description: The home you nurtured together, what will it become after no one takes care of it?
english.name: pass_lv7-39

schinese.description: 首次通关
schinese.name: pass_lv1-1

schinese.description: 过去，家里从来都不会缺少零食
schinese.name: pass_lv1-11

schinese.description: 相伴的时光一去不复返
schinese.name: pass_lv1-22

schinese.description: 你们总是会为最后一块饼干而发生争执
schinese.name: pass_lv1-36

schinese.description: 曾经盛满牛奶的猫碗，如今却空空荡荡
schinese.name: pass_lv2-18

schinese.description: 这是你第一个获得的礼物，你仍能回想起得到它时的喜悦
schinese.name: pass_lv2-28

schinese.description: 你被爱所包围的象征
schinese.name: pass_lv2-32

schinese.description: 你总是被精心打扮起来，吸引了无数羡慕的目光
schinese.name: pass_lv2-40

schinese.description: 餐桌上唯有剩下孤独的你
schinese.name: pass_lv3-10

schinese.description: 毫不吝啬的，你总是被给予最好的东西
schinese.name: pass_lv3-39

schinese.description: 你不想忘记的不仅是童年，还有你们一同成长的点点滴滴
schinese.name: pass_lv4-7

schinese.description: 你永远不会忘记那些温馨的回忆
schinese.name: pass_lv4-19

schinese.description: 即使是闲暇时消磨时光的日子，你也依然将其铭记于心
schinese.name: pass_lv4-30

schinese.description: 你想要丢弃玩具表示已经长大，却未料到成长的代价竟是孤独
schinese.name: pass_lv4-37

schinese.description: 它原本是一个白色小球
schinese.name: pass_lv4-41

schinese.description: 每当你生气时都会咬牙切齿，但现在已经没有生气的对象了
schinese.name: pass_lv5-10

schinese.description: 你们一同经历了无数个新奇的第一次，比如吃罐头
schinese.name: pass_lv5-25

schinese.description: 你不清楚究竟过去了多久，一天？一个月？还是一年？
schinese.name: pass_lv5-27

schinese.description: 你本想当做玩具来珍藏它，没想到最后成为了遗物
schinese.name: pass_lv5-35

schinese.description: 每一次咀嚼，你都会感到爱意涌上心头
schinese.name: pass_lv5-37

schinese.description: 这是白色房子中剩下的最后一个苹果
schinese.name: pass_lv6-8

schinese.description: 从那天起，你就看到越来越多的梨
schinese.name: pass_lv6-10

schinese.description: 自从误食后大病一场，家里就再也没有这种水果了
schinese.name: pass_lv6-18

schinese.description: 你未曾想过这个盛满水的器皿终有一天将会干涸
schinese.name: pass_lv6-22

schinese.description: 不禁回想起你们一同度过的快乐时光
schinese.name: pass_lv6-26

schinese.description: 你依然记得那个在炎热夏日中绽放的幸福笑脸
schinese.name: pass_lv6-31

schinese.description: 你未曾受到过责备，即使是不小心将水杯打翻
schinese.name: pass_lv7-9

schinese.description: 自那天以后，你就讨厌红色，包括过去最喜欢的草莓汁
schinese.name: pass_lv7-14

schinese.description: 是为无法再品尝到熟悉的奶酪而难过吗？还是为再也无法相见的谁？
schinese.name: pass_lv7-32

schinese.description: 你们一起哺育的家园，在无人打理之后将会变成什么样子呢？
schinese.name: pass_lv7-39
